propositions: Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized on-box from SSM at deploy time into a gitignored 0600 .env file as MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* environment variables, never baked into the rsync'd tree or committed to git
The static verifier reads accepted tokens from mcp-static-tokens.json which references materialized PATs via token_env records, never plaintext token values or raw PAT literals in the tokens file
The materialized artifacts (mcp-static-tokens.json and mcp-clients.local.json) must be gitignored and rsync-excluded to prevent value-only rotations from being clobbered or accidentally committed

Bearer token rotation requires operator-driven re-materialization of the SSM secrets followed by restart/replacement of the rebar-mcp process/container; autodeploy no-ops on value-only changes because the verifier loads tokens only once at __init__
A committed template file (mcp-clients.local.example.json) documents the client credential config shape while a real gitignored file (mcp-clients.local.json) holds operator-provided values

Blank-slot behavior: fetch-secrets.sh omits token_env records for unset MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* slots; the tokens file is always created even when all slots are blank; the verifier fails-closed at startup if no tokens are defined
